regression_contract: Canonical sources are imported through the actual Rust development API. All Search replies are explicitly injected and never sent to a native index worker.
Validated replies preserve returned rank by mapping hit IDs to canonical Evidence; rendered count is displayed rows, not reported total precision.
Query A-to-B-to-A and navigation invalidate old generations, errors and pending queued requests.
One active plus one latest pending request; rapid changes coalesce and an obsolete reply cannot clear newer pending/failure.
New attempts, failures, malformed responses and valid empty responses cannot leave prior ranked hits visible.
An actual canonical import revision invalidates a held response; old revision replies are refused on a new request.
A delayed actual import response keeps workspace mutation controls disabled despite old search completion.

Twelve malformed reply variants exercise missing/unknown fields, revision representation, total bounds, duplicate/unknown IDs, wrong names, nonnumeric scores and excess hits; no valid prefix is rendered.
limits: No Rust, Search schema/request/response, native runtime, CSS, layout or public-service change.
Native Lucene execution, index quality, total-hit precision and frozen benchmark eligibility remain unproven by this injected-response suite.
Query association is captured client request state: the current response does not echo a query or provide a search receipt.
Invalidation does not cancel an active backend worker; it clears queued work and prevents obsolete publication.
Existing editable industrial design is reused; no new Figma frame or design acceptance is claimed.
Build/test sources were dirty only with this final patch when verified, then signed with identical file hashes. No native or full-platform release acceptance is claimed.
